subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) Many boat goers were returning home. They were carrying bags, sacks and baskets. (b) But none of them listened to him. (c) As a result, everybody had to suffer for the lack of their impatience and foresight. (d) They needed to cross the river urgently. The reason was that black clouds were gathering in the sky. The weather was getting worse. So everybody was trying to get into the boat ahead of each other. (e) So the boat sank in the middle of the river. (f) It was a boat day. (g) Kalim Majhee was shouting all the time, "My boat will not be able to carry you all in one, trip. You are too many." (h) The boat of Kalim Majhee was their only hope. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (f) + (h) + (a) + (d) + (g) + (b) + (e) + (c) Section B : Writing Test
